[[File:Decipher.com lobby December 1996.jpg|thumb|Lobby on games.decipher.com, December 1996.]]
'''games.decipher.com''' was the first archived [[Decipher.com]] host. The Internet Archive captured it on 2 November 1996, before www.decipher.com (21 November 1996). It served the same lobby and game sections as www, including the 1996 Hoth Contest.<ref name="lobby">[http://games.decipher.com/index.html Welcome To Decipher!], Decipher (December 1996). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19961231210635/http://games.decipher.com/index.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="hoth">[http://games.decipher.com/hothcontest/index.html Hoth Contest], Decipher (1996). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19961102055122/http://games.decipher.com/hothcontest/index.html Internet Archive]</ref>
